verdict.rationale: First-party docs say built-in, OAuth-authenticated connectors let Grok reach email, files, and calendar inside chat. Dedicated connector pages document Gmail search with Gmail operators and Google Drive search, read, and file management, and a combined Gmail/Google Calendar connector exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the connectors work in practice, detail on what the calendar connector can do, and evidence of non-Google drive or email providers such as OneDrive or Outlook.
